answer_1.quote: Motivated by the expert-like potential of autonomous agents, we aim to establish language as a unifying bridge-utilizing multiple LLM-powered agents with specialized roles for cooperative software development through language-based communication across different phases; solutions in different phases are derived from their multi-turn dialogues, whether dealing with text or code.
answer_1.outputs: software solutions through multi-agent dialogue involving natural language and code

answer_2.quote: We apply three fundamental and objective dimensions that reflect different aspects of coding hallucinations to evaluate the agent-generated software, and then integrate them to facilitate a more holistic evaluation: • Completeness measures the software's ability to fulfill code completion in software development... • Executability assesses the software's ability to run correctly within a compilation environment... • Consistency measures how closely the generated software code aligns with the original requirement description... • Quality is a comprehensive metric that integrates various factors to assess the overall quality of software...
